text:
marta: Heads up — nightly Mixtral MoE perf regression on router/top-k for seq_len 1024. Trace attached. Avg p95 token latency +22% vs baseline. Kernel selection seems to pick softmax-fallback on one path. cc @sam @jia

sam: saw it. is this for the new RoPE scaling changes?

marta: yes. we bumped RoPE scale factor from 1.0 -> 1.1 to reduce hallucinations per T-1892. But export now reports head_dim=80 (was 64) and kernel_chooser prefers generic matmul+softmax path.

jia: can you paste the profiler flame / trace snippet?

marta: ran a quick rd-prof, here's the top hot spots:

```
rd-prof --trace run/2026-03-17/mixtral-run1 --filter=router
# hot functions:
router_forward 48.2%
softmax_kernel_generic 26.0%
kv_lookup 12.5%
expert_dispatch 8.7%
```

sam: that softmax_kernel_generic is our slow path. We used tiled-softmax for head_dim multiples of 16 which is ~fast. Kernel selector probably lost the heuristic when head_dim != 64. There's a knob in kernel_selector: PREFER_TILED_SOFTMAX.

jia: also seeing KV cache regressions in the same run — kv_hit_ratio dropped from 0.92 -> 0.82 for the identical workload. Expert cache eviction rate went up. Might be correlated: different per-expert buffer sizing after the head_dim change.

noah: could be expert_shard sizing. If buffer footprint per-token increased, per-gpu expert capacity reduces and eviction rises. Check expert_shard_strategy: round_robin vs capacity_aware.

marta: router config excerpt from the canary run:

```
router:
  top_k: 2
  logits_temp: 1.0
  gate_preference: 'softmax'
kernel_selector:
  prefer_tiled_softmax: null  # trying to toggle in canary
expert:
  parallelism: 8
  cache_size_per_expert: 1.2GB
```

perf-bot: canary result summary: canary-237 p95 token latency baseline=72ms -> canary=88ms :warning: kv_eviction_rate=6.3% kv_hit_ratio=0.81

sam: quick local repro: run with --force-kernel=tiled-softmax and --rope-scale=1.0; perf normalizes. Also note batch_heuristics: dynamic_batch_by_tokens was enabled in the new release which increases batch token variance and can interact poorly with router top-k hotspots.

marta: reprobed: forcing tiled-softmax reduces p95 by ~18% but increases peak GPU mem by ~150MB on our test box. For seq_len 1024 long tails, tiled-softmax wins latency-wise. So option: make kernel choice per-model (prefer tiled-softmax for mixtral-moex with head_dim in {64,80}) or add fallback that switches based on batch token distribution.

jia: we should also make a routing-policy tradeoff: if expert_eviction_rate > 5% then reduce expert_parallelism or lower cache_size_per_expert to avoid thrashing. Add regression alert on eviction_rate.

marta: filed T-2048 with plan: (1) patch kernel_selector to consider head_dim multiples of 8/16 and RoPE-adjusted dims; (2) add model config flag prefer_tiled_softmax; (3) implement a small allocator to estimate per-expert footprint and recommend expert_parallelism; (4) add eviction_rate alert and kv cache tracepoints. I'll land debug patch today and run canary.

noah: also adding tracepoints for avg_entries_per_shard and per-expert tail_latency would help root cause.

deploy-bot: canary-238 started with kernel_selector patch enabled (force toggle = prefer_tiled_softmax=true).

sam: thanks — please ping if the qwen/llama configs regress after this change, they might hit different kernel paths.

marta: good plan. I'll post the profiler traces and updated flame pics in T-2048 once canary finishes. :thumbsup:
